title: Atribuir writers residuales del churn de GitHub Pages
mission: Using read-only GitHub Actions and commit metadata, attribute the remaining gh-pages `pages build and deployment` churn to the concrete writer/workflow families that generate gh-pages heads. Use a bounded window with closed terminal coverage, group deploy runs by originating gh-pages commit and upstream workflow/commit-message evidence, and quantify contribution and cancellation density per writer family. Do not modify workflows and do not infer causality where provenance cannot be resolved.
definition_of_done: A bounded, terminal Pages-build window is fixed with exact run ids and gh-pages head SHAs.
Each included deploy is mapped to a concrete writer/workflow family when GitHub metadata proves it, otherwise classified UNKNOWN with explicit source debt.
Counts and cancellation rates are reported per writer family and reconcile to the total included deploy count.
The already-proven Agent Runtime redundant-writer suppression is treated as prior evidence, not re-proven or generalized.
Any proposed repair remains a separate successor; this job performs no workflow, Current, Served, scheduler, queue or Human Accepted mutation.
